title: Kazoku Robinson Hyouryuuki: Fushigi na Shima no Flone

date-tvdb.reason: 50 episodes on both sides, same order, same titles from 'One Letter' to 'Till Next Time' ('Journey', 'Flone's Change of Heart', 'Towards Australia', 'Captain Flone', ... 'Father Who Can Do Anything' = 'The Father Who Can Do Anything', 'Aim for the Island', ... 'Good Bye Island' = 'Goodbye, Island', 'I Can See Land!'). TVDB gives every episode a consecutive daily placeholder date from 1981-01-04, which is the whole date mismatch. Spot differences are translation only ('Holiday on an Uninhabited Island' = 'Holiday On Inhabited Island').
